abstract.p: A thermal storage module places a sealed phase-change salt pack inside a graphite shell. The shell spreads heat to an aluminum fin array during discharge. The module stores heat from a solar collector for release after sunset.

A silica aerogel layer covers the outside of a stainless steel pipe. A porous ceramic mesh supports the layer and limits cracking during thermal cycling. The coating reduces heat loss in the synthetic test rig.

bibliographic-data.invention-title: Synthetic sodium-ion cell and cathode binder

abstract.p: A sodium-ion cell uses a hard-carbon anode and a Prussian-blue cathode. A water-based binder holds cathode particles on an aluminum current collector. The synthetic test module operates at room temperature.

A cellulose membrane separates two liquid chambers in a synthetic filtration cell. A porous ceramic coating traps filler particles while water passes through the membrane. The fixture contains no measurements of service life.
